in_sanskrit.name: Papay
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Ripe Fruit
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Papay एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Papay is a Hindu name derived from the Sanskrit word 'papāya' which means ripe fruit. It is a unisex name that carries the themes of sweetness, fertility, and abundance.
